title: Understanding the GroupBy Function
text: To analyze the data by staff role, you need to use the `groupby` function. This function allows you to group the data based on a specific column, which in this case is the 'role'.

title: Aggregation Functions
text: When using the `agg` function, you can specify different aggregation operations for different columns. For example, you can find the minimum, maximum, or mean of a column.

title: Choosing the Right Aggregation for $$oh_{tickets}$$
text: Which aggregation function would you use to find the minimum number of office hours tickets resolved by staff in each role?
